name: Larry Gumbel
why: His own senior class studio portrait. The 1989 Talisman index carries exactly one Gumbel in the whole volume, 'Gumbel, Larry Joseph 93', and page 93 is a senior portrait grid; a marketing senior from Louisville in the 1988-89 book matches the Larry Gumbel who was Associated Student Government treasurer that year, and there is no second Gumbel at Western for the face to belong to.

src.label: 1989 Talisman, p. 93, senior portraits (Evans-Hightower). The names run in blocks of five down the right-hand column and each block is one row of five portraits, left to right; Gumbel is second of five in the fourth block and second in the fourth row. The fourth block reads Angela Guinn, Larry J. Gumbel, Laura Jane Gupton, Melissa H. Hamby, Lesley Ellen Hampton, that is woman, man, woman, woman, woman, and the fourth row of faces matches it exactly. The three rows above check out the same way: row 1 reads F M M F F for Evans, Farmer, Fatkin, Feller and Feuerbach, row 2 M F F M M for Fishback, Fisher, Francis, Franklin and Free, and row 3 F F M M M for Frew, Golver, Godbey, Gornet and Groemling.

name: Donna Holloway
why: Her own sophomore class studio portrait, taken in the year she first ran for Associated Student Government office. The 1985 Talisman index carries exactly one Holloway in the volume, 'Holloway, Donna Ann 340', and the archive already records that the Herald of 2 April 1985 printed Greg Elder's letter 'Supports Caroline Miller & Donna Holloway', so the ASG Donna Holloway was a Western student that spring, which is the year this portrait was made. She was Student Affairs vice chair the following year but is not named in either Associated Student Government group photograph in the 1987 Talisman, and no Holloway appears in the 1986 or 1987 volume at all, so this is the only frame of her the yearbooks hold.

src.label: 1985 Talisman, p. 340, sophomore portraits (Hay-Hub). The names run in blocks of six down the left-hand column and each block is one row of six portraits, left to right; Holloway is second of six in the third block and second in the bottom row. The two rows above check the alignment: the first block reads Joel Haywood, William Hearn, Gregory Helton, Jim Henderson, Lisa Hensley, Kim Hewlett, that is four men then two women, and the top row of faces matches it exactly; the second block reads Carla Higdon, Barbara Himes, Lisa Hitchcock, Gary Hobgood, Kathy Hodges, Linda Hodskins, women in every position but the fourth, and the middle row has its only man in the fourth place.
